intent.proves: No storefront shop (ShopType 1) and no feed exists, which the ruling that display groups have no consumer relies on.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomShops WHERE ShopType = 1) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomFeed WHERE ISNULL(FeedIsFolder, 0) = 0)
